name: Codification level
description: The structural tier a piece of legislation occupies within a code. schema:hasPart nests parts but never says what kind of part, which is the one substantive gap in schema.org's otherwise complete legislation vocabulary. Systems differ in which tiers they use and in what order; publishers should use the terms their own code uses and rely on isPartOf for the actual nesting rather than assuming a fixed depth.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Code
hasDefinedTerm.description: The whole consolidated body of law.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Title
hasDefinedTerm.description: A top-level grouping, common in US municipal codes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Book
hasDefinedTerm.description: A top-level grouping, common in civil-law codes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Article
hasDefinedTerm.description: The primary numbered unit in most civil-law systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Section
hasDefinedTerm.description: The primary numbered unit in most common-law systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Schedule
hasDefinedTerm.description: Supplementary material with legal force, appended to the main text.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Annex
hasDefinedTerm.description: Supplementary material, the usual term in EU and civil-law drafting.
